en: Hmm... There are odd scratches on my arms and legs.
How I got them, I haven't the faintest idea.
Hrm, what's this?! You may not enter uninvited!
Who are you? Identify yourself!
I assure you, I am no one suspicious.
Hmph, you don't know me? An outsider, eh?
A foreigner? Don't go poking around here.
I am Lance, Commander of the British Army.
Oh? That's quite a grand position.
Bah, what an infuriating fellow.
Begone at once!
You're a foreigner. What do you want here?
I doubt a spy would march in the front door,
but I'm obliged to question you all the same.
My apologies.
I feared I'd be a bother, but I was nearby,
so I thought I'd stop and pay my respects.
I see. Well, I'll let it pass.
But you may not come in here as you please.
Foreigner or not, I'll not let it slide.
I shall be more careful from now on, then.
Hey! You can't just come in here.
Grrr, you've barged in uninvited again.
What's a grown man doing drifting about?
I've no time to chat with outsiders.
What strangely peaceful times we've come to.
Nothing but petty spats and odd incidents,
and the British Empire's glory has faded.
How deplorable
Hm, still here? I told you to get out.
Do you want to be shouted out of here?
Hmph. What a strange foreigner.
I can't fathom what you're thinking at all.
Try anything funny and you'll pay for it.
Ah, how deplorable
Peace has made the townsfolk soft and lax.
What will become of the Empire at this rate?
The other great powers will outfox us!
And odd foreigners like this one roam about.
One day the British Empire shall conquer the world again.
And on that day, I shall lead the charge...
Hm? Who are you?
You look suspicious. State your name.
What do you want at this hour?
I'd like you to answer a survey.
(Off the cuff or not, that was a poor lie.)
note: Player thought, parentheses kept; stern register

en: Hmph. You're suspicious, just as I thought.
And what good would answering it do?
In any case, you're a nuisance. Go home.
You heard me tell you to go home, did you not?
You're that foreigner from before. What is it?
Another of your phony surveys?
Can't you make a living without such work?
And you a man! Ugh, how deplorable.
Again?! That's quite enough.
Have you foreigners no pride at all?
Hm... it's you.
Well, all right.
I suppose you have your own hardships.
Is life in a foreign land a lonely one?
Britain is a fine nation, and a mighty one.
It can take in even foreigners like you.
Live in harmony with the people of the city.
At any rate, you're no suspicious character—
